name: inprocess-cv32e20-timer1-overflow-f5-fuzz
notes: The second CPU artifact for the same new declaration: CV32E20 instead of Ibex, with the timer1 overflow file configs/behaviors/pulp_timer1_overflow_f5.json.  Both CPUs declare a one-bit active-high machine-external IRQ input on OBI, so this run shows the declaration is CPU-independent; it does not demonstrate a different IRQ ABI, and the report says so
the CPU profile is the only difference from configs/scenarios/inprocess-obi-apb-ibex-timer1-overflow-f5-fuzz.json apart from the notes
the timer declares 50 MHz, the CPU 50 MHz and the ZipDMA a nominal 1 Hz simulation rate, so assume_single_clock states that one host tick drives all three models
two IRQ sources are declared: the target's pulse on irq_o[2] and the ZipDMA completion level
